subject: [PATCH v5 4/9] mm/collapse: add collapse.h for the collapse interface

2026-10-15.patch_summary: This patch adds a new header file, mm/collapse.h, to separate the interface and implementation of the collapse functionality from khugepaged.c. The new header defines an enum for scan results and a struct for control parameters, as well as two constants that were previously defined in khugepaged.c. This separation is intended to make the code more modular and easier to maintain.
